description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Intramotev is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to develop software for its self-propelled battery-electric railcars and vehicles. The role involves writing and testing software, debugging on real hardware, and collaborating with mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers across embedded, application, controls, or perception domains.
Associate Software Engineer developing and testing defined software components, debugging on vehicle hardware and integrating with vehicle systems

Responsibilities:
• Write clean, testable, well-commented code for defined components in embedded, full-stack/application, controls, or perception software, depending on your placement
• Test and debug your own code to root cause, working from written requirements and acceptance criteria
• Debug and validate software behavior on real vehicle hardware alongside senior engineers
• Use git and established team workflows for code review, issue tracking, and release
• Work with mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers to integrate your software with the rest of the vehicle

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field
• 0–2 years of software development experience, including relevant internship, co-op, or university research/project experience — coursework and team projects count
• Proficiency in at least one programming language such as C, C++, C#, Python, or a comparable object-oriented language
• Working understanding of the software development lifecycle, including reading requirements, writing tests, debugging, and version control (git)
• Willingness to expand into technical areas beyond your area of expertise; ability to develop innovative and novel approaches
• Open-minded and comfortable working in a teaming environment as an individual contributor
• Fluent in both written and verbal English
• Authorized to work in the United States. Candidates on F-1 OPT or STEM OPT are welcome to apply. Intramotev does not sponsor H-1B or other employment visas, so employment on OPT is limited to the length of that authorization

Preferred:
• Candidate should have a working knowledge of one or (ideally) multiple areas listed below:
• Firmware on microcontrollers, RTOS, CAN/serial buses, bring-up and debugging on real hardware (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, JTAG)
• Web or mobile front ends, backend services and databases, REST/gRPC APIs, industrial HMI, Android
• MATLAB/Simulink or other model-based development, control theory coursework, hardware-in-the-loop or simulation work
• OpenCV, PyTorch/TensorFlow, ROS/ROS 2, point clouds, sensor calibration, dataset tooling
• Experience in a directly applicable domain such as rail, electric vehicles, robotics, automotive, aerospace, or unmanned systems — including university competition teams (Formula SAE, Baja, robotics, autonomous vehicle challenges)
• Demonstrated experience working on cross-disciplinary project teams alongside mechanical, electrical, or systems engineers
